profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I’m a full stack software developer with experience building software that uses generative AI and machine learning to streamline and automate business processes and workflows.

My tech stack is JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node, Python, FastAPI, Java, Spring, LangChain, LangGraph.

I graduated from The George Washington University with a B.S. in Computer Science.

Active Public Trust.  Remote only.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Design and build chatbots and generative AI applications with agentic workflows and RAG.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning · Chatbots · Java · Python (Programming Language) · LangChain · LangGraph · React.js · FastAPI · Next.js

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Provide software development, systems integration, and cloud computing services.

Created model to do sentiment analysis by training it with public restaurant reviews dataset using Hugging Face Transformers.

Built timesheet app for tracking hours worked on contracts using React, Redux, React Router, MUI, IndexedDB.  https://timesheet.vinhnguyen.org/

Built tennis score keeping app built using React and IndexedDB.  https://vinhnguyen.org/tennis/

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built a web app to automate and enhance a manual, spreadsheet based process featuring data import/export, dashboards, charts, reporting, APIs.  Also built a desktop version.
positions.insights: Skills: NgRx · Chart.js · Angular · Electron · Node.js · MySQL · TypeScript · Express.js · Angular Material · REST APIs

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web developer for the DARPA Subterranean Challenge Virtual Robotics Competition portal.  Built new features, implemented reactive state management, and improved performance by refactoring app functionality into modules which were loaded on demand.
positions.insights: Skills: NgRx · HTML · Angular · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Provide software development support for an AI product.

positions.title: Sr. Cloud Engineer
positions.description: Performed analysis of legacy applications and developed plan for migration to the AWS cloud.  Refactored Java applications to use modern frameworks such as Spring.  Integrated applications with SAML identity provider for authentication.  Configured WS-Security for web services.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · Maven · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Eclipse

positions.title: Cloud Software Developer
positions.description: Built the first release of the Defense Export Control and Compliance System (DECCS) that allowed industry to electronically submit Commodity Jurisdiction requests to the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (DDTC) in the Department of State.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Spring Framework · XML · Maven · Angular · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Java · Microsoft Azure · Eclipse · NoSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Built software that automates business processes and workflows for the organization.  Converted a legacy web application to ExtJS and Spring MVC.  Built a REST style web service API for integration of data and services.  Received award for outstanding service.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · Ext JS · Maven · Java · Web Services · Eclipse · JavaScript · REST APIs
